risks.risk: Exact PS4 model/edition is not readable; pricing depends heavily on whether it’s a true special edition bundle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label (underside/back) showing model number (e.g., CUH-xxxx) and any edition markings, plus a photo of the box/edition name if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard PS4 slim console bundle with unknown/possibly missing accessories (worst case for edition value).

risks.risk: Bundle contents may be incomplete (controller type/quantity, cables, headset, games).
risks.proof: A single laid-out photo showing every included item with a count (controller(s), cables, box, manuals, games).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (or console + minimal essentials) until all accessories are shown.

risks.risk: Functional status (disc drive, HDMI port, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, controller pairing) is unknown from photos.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on to the home screen, controller pairing, and (if applicable) disc loading/ejection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst-case not working for disc or ports (i.e., discount heavily) until a working demo is provided.

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition may hide issues (scratches, missing ports/covers, overheating damage).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of ports (HDMI, USB), vents, and any visible wear; plus a photo of the underside/serial area.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming moderate wear and potential minor damage risk.

proof_requests: Photo of the console underside/back label showing the exact model number (CUH-xxxx) and serial/region.
A laid-out photo of all included accessories (controller(s), cables, headset, box, games) with counts.
A short video: power on → home screen → controller connects; if disc version, show disc tray open/close and a disc test.
response.reason: From photo 0, I can only confirm it looks like a PS4 slim console, but the “special edition” and the claimed controller/accessories and functionality are not shown. Without bundle contents and working proof, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
